description: The file defines the ProductEntity class, which extends Product and implements Serializable. It adds attributes such as price, SKU, dimensions, weight, rating, availability, and various flags related to product characteristics. It includes getters and setters for these attributes, serving as a data holder for product information in the application.

classes.name: ProductEntity
classes.description: A data class representing a product with additional attributes like price, dimensions, SKU, and flags for virtual, free, shippable, and availability status. It extends Product and serializable for data transfer within the application.
